messages:
Lina Moreno: Heads-up: NorthBridge is evaluating switching from NorthStar API -> Redwood for their chat product. Top concerns from CTO: API parity, pricing for demo surge, and their security questionnaire. Can sales/eng/security triage?
Ethan Wu: I'll take parity work. Do they stream and use candidate arrays?
Lina Moreno: They stream chat and expect `candidates[]` in responses for reranking.
Priya Desai: Security asks: SOC2, KMS support, SSO (SAML), subprocessor list. They also want data residency confirmation.
sec-bot: [auto] Uploaded questionnaire: https://redwood-internal/sec/northbridge-poc
Ethan Wu: Parity plan: stand up a Compass-style proxy on staging that accepts their payloads, maps `messages`->`input`, maps model names, preserves message IDs, and emits `partial_delta`/`done` events for stream. Will add `usage.prompt_tokens` and `usage.completion_tokens` in final JSON.
Marco Silva: For rerank flow we must keep stable candidate ids. Proxy will generate deterministic ids derived from hash so rerank calls can reference them.
Priya Desai: KMS note: For Private deployments we support CMKs (AWS/GCP). For hosted SaaS we can offer envelope encryption with customer KMS under a limited pilot. I'll draft answer for questionnaire.
Lina Moreno: Procurement: "What happens if traffic spikes 2x during demo?"
Marco Silva: Offer trial credits + temporary burst cap; finance to confirm overage pricing. We'll set alerts at 1.25x and a hard throttle at 3x for safety.
Ethan Wu: Action items: 1) Marco implement id mapping in proxy (due EOD+3). 2) Ethan run parity matrix on 10 prompts (due EOD+4). 3) Priya draft security replies (due EOD+2). 4) Lina confirm demo date with customer (today).
Lina Moreno: Demo set for next Tuesday 9am PT. 15m tech sync at 8:30 to walk the script. Who can join?
Ethan Wu: I'll join.
Marco Silva: On it.
Priya Desai: I'll be there for security Qs.
Lina Moreno: Thanks team. Post short status updates here only. :thumbsup:
